variables.name: IANA_TOP_LEVEL_DOMAINS
variables.comment:
*  Regular expression to match all IANA top-level domains.
     *
     *  List accurate as of 2023/09/11.  List taken from:
     *  http://data.iana.org/TLD/tlds-alpha-by-domain.txt
     *  This pattern is auto-generated by frameworks/ex/common/tools/make-iana-tld-pattern.py

variables.name: UCS_CHAR
variables.comment: * Valid UCS characters defined in RFC 3987. Excludes space characters.

variables.name: LABEL_CHAR
variables.comment: * Valid characters for IRI label defined in RFC 3987.

variables.name: TLD_CHAR
variables.comment: * Valid characters for IRI TLD defined in RFC 3987.

variables.name: IRI_LABEL
variables.comment: * RFC 1035 Section 2.3.4 limits the labels to a maximum 63 octets.

variables.name: PUNYCODE_TLD
variables.comment: * RFC 3492 references RFC 1034 and limits Punycode algorithm output to 63 characters.

variables.name: WORD_BOUNDARY
variables.comment: A word boundary or end of input.  This is to stop foo.sure from matching as foo.su

variables.name: WEB_URL
variables.comment:
*  Regular expression pattern to match most part of RFC 3987
     *  Internationalized URLs, aka IRIs.

variables.name: STRICT_TLD
variables.comment: * Regular expression that matches known TLDs and punycode TLDs

variables.name: STRICT_HOST_NAME
variables.comment: * Regular expression that matches host names using {@link #STRICT_TLD}

variables.name: STRICT_DOMAIN_NAME
variables.comment:
* Regular expression that matches domain names using either {@link #STRICT_HOST_NAME} or
     * {@link #IP_ADDRESS}

variables.name: RELAXED_DOMAIN_NAME
variables.comment: * Regular expression that matches domain names without a TLD

variables.name: WEB_URL_WITHOUT_PROTOCOL
variables.comment:
* Regular expression to match strings that do not start with a supported protocol. The TLDs
     * are expected to be one of the known TLDs.

variables.name: WEB_URL_WITH_PROTOCOL
variables.comment:
* Regular expression to match strings that start with a supported protocol. Rules for domain
     * names and TLDs are more relaxed. TLDs are optional.

variables.name: AUTOLINK_WEB_URL
variables.comment:
* Regular expression pattern to match IRIs. If a string starts with http(s):// the expression
     * tries to match the URL structure with a relaxed rule for TLDs. If the string does not start
     * with http(s):// the TLDs are expected to be one of the known TLDs.
     *

variables.name: EMAIL_CHAR
variables.comment:
* Regular expression for valid email characters. Does not include some of the valid characters
     * defined in RFC5321: #&~!^`{}/=$*?|

variables.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS_LOCAL_PART
variables.comment:
* Regular expression for local part of an email address. RFC5321 section 4.5.3.1.1 limits
     * the local part to be at most 64 octets.

variables.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS_DOMAIN
variables.comment:
* Regular expression for the domain part of an email address. RFC5321 section 4.5.3.1.2 limits
     * the domain to be at most 255 octets.

variables.name: AUTOLINK_EMAIL_ADDRESS
variables.comment:
* Regular expression pattern to match email addresses. It excludes double quoted local parts
     * and the special characters #&~!^`{}/=$*?| that are included in RFC5321.
